payload.entry:
Baseline: is_quote_continuation_line rejected every is_markdown_heading line, so a hard-wrapped `# ` sidecar line ended the quote; parse_sidecar_chunk then dropped that line and sent the rest to Comment. Live read-only repros: gastown_readme p.8 missing "Set default agent"; sase_listen_antennapod_setup p.4 missing "# should start with <?xml".

Fix: in linked style, heading-shaped wrap immediately after a quote line is quote continuation unless it is a page heading or an annotation-date header (`##### YYYY-MM-DD:`). Comments still start after a blank line, Comment:/Note: labels, or marker-list fields. highlight_id_on_quote_fix=remint: quote text is identity, so the two notes remint and tombstone on the next highlights sync (not edited in the live vault).

Validation: fixture tests/fixtures/highlights_ref/quote_heading_sidecar.md; parser/render/remint unit tests; live sidecar parse on this host (both quotes keep the `# ` line, comment=None); just docs-check; just check green (fmt, clippy, cargo test --no-fail-fast).

Remaining: bob-cli-ba left open for the lander. Recovery is the next bob ref scan/sync. No --epic-symbol leftovers.

Verified: link/child-insert/start all reuse completed DEEP WORK (was DEEP-WORK). Added completed_only_reuse_name helper in capture_pomodoros.rs; used by named_creation_name, insert_named_placeholder (relocation), insert_named_pomodoro_child_block, plan_pomodoro_start, project_note. 3 new CLI regressions in tests/cli/capture/pomodoro_link.rs (link_form_reuses..., link_with_start_moves..., link_with_start_creates...) failed pre-fix, pass post-fix. Focused suites green (214 pomodoro CLI, 35 toggle/link/project CLI, 21 capture_pomodoros + 61 task_toggle + 153 completion unit). just check exit=0 on retry (3234 lib + 1985 cli); first full run hit two parallel-run flakes (curl ETXTBSY, ingest lock timing) that pass on both trees in isolation. Task bead bob-cli-bb left open for the lander.
